For further details contact us at https://mythospedals.com/pages/contact The Olympus Overdrive is a tribute to the incredible Gainster/Hoochie Mama circuit that has become much sought after on the used market. Known by many as a “Klon-Killer” and for good reason, it’s a powerful yet musical overdrive that only enhances what you already have. Olympus Overdrive Click image to enlarge Appearance of new instruments may vary slightly unless Serial Number is listed Mythos Pedals - Olympus Overdrive $179.00 Default Title - $179.00 In Stock - Free Shipping Eligible The Mythos Pedals - Olympus Overdrive brings the Spartan series model into the classic Mythos lineup, here with the standard-sized box and pedalboard friendly top jacks. This three-knob overdrive takes it's inspiration from the Gainster/Hoochie Mama circuit that has become hot on the used pedal market. Dynamic, tweed-like voicing that runs well as a low gain boost all the way up to an a full on overdrive. As always, a great, versatile and usable pedal from Mythos. From Mythos: The Olympus is back and now part of the regular Mythos lineup! We took the “Spartan” series has been condensed into a smaller package but still retains all the great tone found in the original unit. The Olympus Overdrive is a tribute to the incredible Gainster/Hoochie Mama circuit that has become much sought after on the used market. Known by many as a “Klon-Killer” and for good reason, it’s a powerful yet musical overdrive that only enhances what you already have. The Olympus features three interactive controls, Volume, Presence and Gain. The Presence and Gain controls work together to achieve anything from smooth lead tones to bright and chimey rhythm sounds. The overall tone has a very “tweed” like mid push but it’s overwhelming and doesn’t mask the tone you guitar and amp have while the pedal is off. The only change is the new version has increased low end and slight increase to overall gain to give it a bit more flexibility. Natural voicing that compliments your guitar Wide range of tones from the interactive controls Increased low end and gain compared to original True Bypass Wiring Top Mount Jacks Approx. 10 mA Current Draw All Mythos Pedals operate on standard 9 volt dc power adapters.
